node.subject: english
node.name: 用上下文推断生词
node.definition: 借助定义、例子、对比或结果推断陌生词的大致义。

lesson.definition: 借助定义、例子、对比或结果推断陌生词的大致义。
lesson.foundation: 词义题的证据可能在破折号、释义从句、举例和转折中。先找线索再概括。
lesson.principle: 定义线索能直接等义。对比只提供语义方向，需结合对象和后文约束，避免推得过精细。
lesson.approach: 先圈陌生词修饰的对象，再找可替换词，最后检查句子前后是否连贯。

examples.prompt: The room was dim: only one small lamp was on. dim 指？
examples.solution: 冒号后只亮了一盏小灯，说明房间光线不足。

examples.prompt: Unlike the flimsy paper cover, the plastic cover remained firm after repeated use. flimsy 指？
examples.solution: 由 unlike 和 remained firm 推出纸封面偏薄弱；并无证据说明它昂贵或不能防水。

lesson.error: 由一个情绪词猜测全文，忽略被修饰对象。把修饰关系和线索句一起复述。
lesson.standard: 面对陌生词能指出线索类型，推断适度词义并排除至少一个不合语境的选项。
lesson.application: 科技说明文里的术语通常能通过定义或用途得到足够的阅读解释。

questions.prompt: The device is portable, so two pupils can carry it between rooms. portable 指？
questions.explanation: 后半句给出能搬动的结果。

questions.prompt: The material is porous: water passes through its tiny holes. porous 指？
The path was slippery; several walkers lost their footing. slippery 指？
questions.explanation: 后半句说明多人滑倒或失去站稳能力。

questions.prompt: Unlike the main hall, the annex is small and was added to the side of the building later. annex 指？
questions.explanation: 位置、大小和增建时间共同约束。

questions.prompt: The instructions were ambiguous, so builders read them in two different ways. ambiguous 指？
questions.explanation: 不同读法说明可以有多种理解。
